name: Adnuntius
description: Renders Adnuntius.com ad units in Drupal as a block or as an entity field, using admin-defined ad units and a client-side ad script.
project_description: The Adnuntius module renders Adnuntius.com ad units on a Drupal site. An administrator defines a catalog of ad units (label, Adnuntius auId, width, height, weight) at /admin/config/services/adnuntius, then places them either through the 'Adnuntius Block' block plugin or through an 'Adnuntius' field attached to any fieldable entity. Each placement renders a themed inline snippet that loads Adnuntius' client-side adn.js from cdn.adnuntius.com and requests the chosen ad unit, using one of two delivery (invocation) methods: 'div' or 'iframe'. The module makes no server-side call to Adnuntius; all ad delivery happens in the visitor's browser. Depends only on Drupal core Block and Field.
